tracks.localFormOverrideBasis: No verified statewide form covers the § 5.2(g) same-day, same-hearing mechanism. The statewide adult suite governs other Illinois tracks and expressly not this one. The override is recorded by the design as unverified, and that is carried as a release blocker rather than resolved here.
tracks.venueAuthority: The courtroom in which the case is disposed. The petition is filed with the circuit clerk during that hearing.

destination.name: Presiding trial judge at the disposition hearing
destination.detail: A copy is served on the State's Attorney in open court and on no one else. The presiding trial judge enters an order granting or denying during the same hearing.

tracks.localFormOverrideBasis: No statewide form exists for the § 5.2(j)(3) route. It remains a counsel-approved custom pleading with a verified local-form override, and a published local form controls where one exists.
tracks.citationRestriction: Cite only § 5.2(j)(3), the mechanics at (d)(9)(A) and the effect at (j)(8). § 5.2(a)(3)(C)(i) is pinned as track authority and deliberately not cited in the pleading.
tracks.venueAuthority: The circuit court with jurisdiction over the underlying conviction, the Chief Judge of that judicial circuit, or any judge of the circuit designated by the Chief Judge.

destination.name: Circuit court of the underlying conviction, or the Chief Judge or a designated judge of that circuit
destination.detail: The State's Attorney receives notice and has 60 days to object with supporting evidence. No statewide form exists, so the filing method must be confirmed with the clerk.
